# README / wiki terminal demos

GitHub READMEs cannot play video tags reliably, so animated terminals are
**GIFs** generated by [VHS](https://github.com/charmbracelet/vhs) from `.tape`
scripts.

```bash
# from repo root
./docs/demo/record.sh              # all
./docs/demo/record.sh tui ui wizard
```

Requires `vhs`, `ffmpeg`, `ttyd`, and `nix` on `PATH`.

## Tapes

| File | GIF | Shows |
|---|---|---|
| [nxr.tape](nxr.tape) | [nxr.gif](nxr.gif) | list/run, inspect, graph, parallel tasks, shell, watch |
| [nxr-tui.tape](nxr-tui.tape) | [nxr-tui.gif](nxr-tui.gif) | `--output tui` DAG watch |
| [nxr-ui.tape](nxr-ui.tape) | [nxr-ui.gif](nxr-ui.gif) | `nxr ui` Apps/Tasks/Scripts browser |
| [nxr-wizard.tape](nxr-wizard.tape) | [nxr-wizard.gif](nxr-wizard.gif) | deploy-wizard → staging/prod tasks |
| [record.sh](record.sh) | — | Build `nxr` + run VHS |

Recording suppresses Nix dirty-tree warnings and warms fixture eval when needed
so the GIF stays readable.
